nodes.speaker: Garrick
nodes.text: You've got a lantern. Good. A lantern is how you tell the dark what matters.

nodes.speaker: Garrick
nodes.text: But light doesn't swing back. For that...
[i]He sets a feather on the anvil and takes the hammer to its nib. Four clean strikes. No bending.[/i]

nodes.speaker: Garrick
nodes.text: A Quill. Not a sword. A sword ends things. This one rewrites them.

nodes.speaker: Garrick
nodes.text: Go on. Hit the dummy. Three times. Don't think about whether it's pretty.
